videos.name: Squid Game: Making Season 2
videos.overview: From set designs to character arcs, get exclusive cast and director interviews on how Season 2 of the globally most-watched series was brought to life.

videos.name: Squid Game: Making Season 1
videos.overview:
If you loved Squid Game too, we've got a nice surprise for you. We're taking you behind the scenes of the phenomenon series, as if you were there. 30 minutes of strolling through each scene, without commentary, just to feel the atmosphere of the shoot.

The only disappointment: zero squid present.
